AI BOQ Import
fields.description: Used by 'Import with AI' on the BOQ: the AI reads the client's Excel and works out items, bills and sections. Quantities and rates are always copied from the Excel itself. Without a key, a built-in reader is used.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Leave empty for the default (Gemini: gemini-flash-lite-latest, always the current Flash-Lite with the highest free daily limit; Groq: llama-3.3-70b-versatile). For harder files try gemini-flash-latest.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Gemen's own key. Gemini: aistudio.google.com > Get API key (free). Groq: console.groq.com > API Keys (free). Stored encrypted.

fields.options: Free plans have daily limits; one BOQ needs about 1 request per 250 lines. On free plans the provider may use the data to improve its models.
